purpose: Responsive layout shell that anchors a collapsible column beside main content and swaps to a drawer below a configurable breakpoint.
useWhen: Wrapping the page chrome so a navigation column can collapse and become a mobile drawer automatically.
Sharing collapsed state between a side-navigation column and the rest of the app shell via context.

avoidWhen.reason: Building the page body itself rather than the surrounding shell — use a hand-rolled page scaffold instead.
Rendering navigation entries directly — place side-navigation inside the sidebar column.
Needing only an accessible nav landmark, not a responsive collapsing shell.
